enterCommissionToClaimTask.doc: EN: home-screen bottom bar. 'Commissions' can OCR as one token with its neighbour ('Commissions Platoon'), so match unanchored inside an ROI that covers only the Commissions icon + label (same ROI as DispatchCenter-enterCommissionPage).

waitingForClaimPageLoading.doc: EN: the count after 'Daily Objectives' (e.g. 10/13) sits further right than in CN because the label is longer, so the CN roi lands on the label text.

enterJourneyWitnessTab.doc: EN: the tab bar OCRs as one box ('Regular Commissions Journey Witness Journey Milestone'), so read only this tab's area to click the right tab.

enterJourneyMileStoneTab.doc: EN: same merged tab bar as enterJourneyWitnessTab; without its own roi the click lands on Journey Witness.
